method: A tempo beat lasts 60/BPM seconds. A bar contains meterBeats × 4 ÷ (meterUnit × tempo beat's quarter-note length) tempo beats, where whole, half, quarter, dotted-quarter, eighth and sixteenth notes have quarter-note lengths 4, 2, 1, 1.5, 0.5 and 0.25 respectively. Each section performs bars × repeats bars; its duration is performed bars × beats per bar × 60/BPM. Section durations are summed in order to produce the timeline and total. Written bars omit repeats; performed bars include them. Pickup bars, gaps, fermatas and tempo changes are outside the model. Inputs and results remain unrounded in the calculation core; only displayed times are rounded to tenths of a second.
